heading: Tax imposed
lead: A tax is hereby imposed on every generation-skipping transfer (within the meaning of subchapter B).

notes.text: Amendments1986—Pub. L. 99–514 amended section generally, substituting “(within the meaning of subchapter B)” for “in the amount determined under section 2602”.
